**How to falsify it:** Absence of pathogenic variants in COL18A1 in patients with Knobloch syndrome 1, or absence of pathogenic variants in MMP2 or COL18A1 in patients with multicentric osteolysis, nodulosis, and arthropathy, would falsify this hypothesis.
